newsitem.title: USA: American Bingo & Gaming optimistic about future.
newsitem.headline: American Bingo & Gaming optimistic about future.

text.p: American Bingo & Gaming Corp said Friday it was optimistic about its future despite a decline in its stock price.
"The company's cash flow is very healthy and cash balances have also nearly doubled since the beginning of the year," it said. "Management believes the company's outlook is very bright."
The stock price closed near the year low of 1-2/16 at 1-7/16 on September 12.

"We cannot account for the recent stock price decline," it said. "At current price levels, our stock clearly does not reflect the company's current annual revenue growth rate in excess of 50 percent, annualized 1996 year-to-date earnings of $0.18 per share, nor our tremendous future growth prospects.
"We will continue to take all necessary steps to increase shareholder value," he added.
The company also said it had signed a letter of intent to acquire three bingo centers in Mississippi.
The acquisition, to be completed in the fourth quarter of the year, will bring the number of centers it operates to 15 from 12, it said.
The company said it would finance the deal through a stock-for-stock exchange plus cash without elaborating.
It said it planned to acquire several more centers by the end of the year.
"Management expects new acquisitions to add directly to the company's cash flow and bottom line," it said.
American Bingo & Gaming Corp is the largest public bingo center lessor in the United States.
